en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Husayn Bin Yazeed, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Aliasws Bin Al-Husaynasws met a slave of hisasws on a cold night and upon himasws was a rod of khazz, a gown of khazz, and a turban of khazz, and heasws had applied Al-Ghaliya. So he said to himasws, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! In a time like this, upon this beard, where to (are youasws going)?’ So heasws said: ‘To the Masjid of myasws grandfathersaww Rasool-Allahsaww, to address the Maiden Hourie to Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from al-Husayn ibn Yazid from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

‘Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, came face to face with one of his Mawla’ in a cold night wearing a gown, a robe and a turban of al-Khazz (garments made of skin or fur of an animal that lives in water), covered with al-Ghaliyah. He said, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, where are you going in such a night and in such a dress?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘I am going to the Masjid of my grandfather, the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, to propose marriage with al-Hur al-‘In before Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious.”’
